g.text: One checkout, two wirings — latency and availability compose very differently
SYNCHRONOUS · the caller waits for every hop
Email is down → checkout is down, even though nobody thinks email is critical to taking money.
ASYNCHRONOUS · only the critical path blocks
Queue / log (write is part of the order txn)
· consumer down → messages wait, nothing lost
· caller's latency no longer bound to theirs
· cost: at-least-once, so consumers must be
idempotent, and failures need dead letters
does the caller need the result
to continue? yes → sync, no → async
